title.narrative: Renewable energy technology for seaweed value added in Tawi-Tawi

description.narrative: Renewable energy technologies for seaweed value added in Tawi-Tawi (RETS). UNIDO has been collaborating with the Philippine Department of Energy (DoE) on various sustainable energy projects, particularly on promoting industrial energy efficiency. DoE has expressed interest in expanding this collaboration through the development of a proposal on #Promotion of Hybrid Renewable Energy Micro-Grid System for Off-Grid Rural Electrification in the Philippines#, which was submitted for inclusion in the country#s Global Environment Facility (GEF) portfolio. Embedded in the ongoing collaboration and pipeline of projects are policy and capacity-building components aimed at strengthening national programs to promote renewable energy, energy efficiency and providing access to modern energy services, which reflect the main objectives of SE4ALL. The current proposal entitled "Renewable energy technology for seaweed value added in Tawi-Tawi" is aimed at assisting the government in its electrification targets, particularly in the underserved areas of the country.
